name: TCL 65C735 (Smart TV Pro, G05, MediaTek), France; also TCL 55C728, Turkey, TCL 65C935, France, and TCL 65C745, France
warnings: The TCL Channel button never reaches the accessibility helpers, so it cannot be mapped.

USB debugging and USB devices: a USB Ethernet adapter kept working when debugging was switched on, but after a reboot with debugging on the port came up in gadget mode (sys.usb.config=adb, Mstar-udc) and the adapter never appeared as a network interface (LED blinking, no eth1).
With launcherx disabled these buttons do nothing; an accessibility service that catches those keycodes and starts the app fixes it (verified with the real remote).
